name: _fake
install: none; the adapter is a shell script (jq and curl in the image for serve)
mcp_config_path: none; serve calls HE_WORLD_MCP_URL directly with curl when a prompt carries [fake:call <tool> <json>]
multi_user_mode: scripted: one session file per key under /harness-state/fake/sessions, no sharing between keys

serve.reply: fixed text echoing the requester's name, the turn, the conversation and the session turn count

notes: Protocol fixture for tests/adapter-conformance.test.ts. It never calls a model.
gbrain_mcp: serve calls HE_GBRAIN_MCP_URL (the world's /gbrain tap) with curl and HE_GBRAIN_MCP_TOKEN (the world bot token) when a prompt carries [fake:gbrain <tool> <json>] or [fake:gbrain tools/list {}]; nothing when the two variables are unset
